text_block_list.text: One day, as I passed by the dormitory—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
*cough*! I'm fine, Flower-chan, dear.
I can't afford to rest over something like this...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No way...
If you keep pushing yourself while unwell, you'll collapse eventually...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Creek-san, you've caught a cold, yet you say you still have things you must do...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Doing the laundry, cleaning, putting everyone to sleep... There are so many children waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I have to go to them and lend them my support...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Creek-san...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Then I'll take your place, Creek-san! Please leave everyone to me!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Eh... But if we do that, I won't get to pamper everyo—no, wouldn't that just be troubling you, Flower-chan?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Please don't worry about troubling me...! More than that, I really want to help everyone!
choice_data_list: Why not leave it to her?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm... It's disappointing that I can't look after them myself, but... alright.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you will make a splendid mama for everyone, Flower-chan.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll do my very best!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oguri-san! I came to deliver your bento in place of Creek-san!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That is... my face. Is this what they call a character bento...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! I wanted to make your meal fun... so I packed it full of all your favorite foods♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see... Thank you. ...Hehe, it's cute.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Taishin-sa~n, it's time for our scheduled training!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Scheduled...? I heard Creek-san went home early though?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, so I'll be running alongside you in her place! As long as it's medium distance, I can keep up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh... A-Alright, fine.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ya really didn't need to go outta yer way to do all this...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No, I must! I'm Creek-san's stand-in! I'll make sure to give you a thorough massage!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Phew, thanks a bunch. Still, yer seriously dutiful, huh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Creek-san told me she gives you a massage after training, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...And then at the very end, if I remember correctly... she gives you headpats to finish it off, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I don't need that part!
And so, Nishino Flower finished going around taking care of everyone.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was a lot tougher than I thought it would be.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Creek-san is truly amazing. To be able to support so many girls like this—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, it was the same for me when I first arrived at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I was feeling so lonely and insecure, but she treated me so kindly and said, 'Think of me as your mama and rely on me whenever you need.' ...I was so happy, and felt so relieved.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I thought to myself... how wonderful it would be if I could become someone who supports others, just like Creek-san.
choice_data_list: I hope you can become like her someday.
I hope you can become like her someday.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I thought to myself... how wonderful it would be if I could become someone who supports others, just like Creek-san.
choice_data_list: I hope you can become like her someday.
I hope you can become like her someday.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I might not have done things the exact same way she does... but if I was able to help everyone in my own way, that makes me really glad♪
choice_data_list: You should have more confidence in yourself.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, so... if it wouldn't be a bother, I have something for you too—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Here, it's potpourri! It's filled with flowers that have a relaxing scent to relieve fatigue, so please take it...!
Afterwards—thanks to the potpourri I received, I was able to relax and fully focus on my work.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes... I hope so too♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, do you have some time after this? I have tea leaves made from the flowers I grew.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, I was thinking I could brew some for you—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, okay♪
The tea brewed by Nishino Flower was filled with heartfelt gratitude for accompanying her throughout the day.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! I feel like today brought me just a little bit closer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Someday, I want to become just like Creek-san—a kind, dependable, and splendid grown-up♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There, there~ Mama is right here for you~♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: M-Me too! So, um... please feel free to rely on me and be pampered, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Um, is something wrong?
choice_data_list: No... Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you for your concern.
A sudden hallucination... Was that a vision of the future, or—
